parts.title: Into the Orchard
parts.text: Elias, June, and Sunil went to an apple orchard. The morning air was **crisp** and cool. A **cluster** of red apples hung on a low branch. June had to **reach** for one up high. It was big and **plump**.

parts.title: Picking Apples
parts.text: Elias carried a **bushel** basket. Soon it was **heavy**, and Sunil helped him lift it.

parts.title: Taste Test
parts.text: Sunil bit a green apple. It was so **sour** that he scrunched up his face! June’s red apple was sweet and **scrumptious**. Elias liked a **tangy** one that tasted bright and zingy. Then he used his sleeve to **polish** an apple until it was **gleaming**. June began to **peel** hers to share.

parts.title: Home Again
parts.text: The sun began to set. The friends carried their apples to the car. They were tired and happy. “Let’s come back next year,” said June.

Ana and Dad went to an orchard to pick apples. A _(1)_ of red apples hung together on one branch. Ana stood on her toes to _(2)_ up high. The apple she picked was round and _(3)_.

Dad filled a _(4)_ with apples, and it got very _(5)_. Ana took a bite of one green apple. It was so _(6)_ that her lips puckered. Then she tried a red one that was cold and _(7)_, with a loud crunch. Dad’s was _(8)_ and zingy, a taste she liked. Ana helped _(9)_ an apple for her baby brother.

At home, Mom would bake a _(10)_ pie. Ana used a cloth to _(11)_ one apple until it was _(12)_.
